statement_download.label: Statement download
statement_download.text: Steps: 1. Go to your profile. 2. Select the 'Reports' option. 3. Under 'Tax', find 'Mutual Fund - Capital Gains'. 4. Choose the financial year and click 'Download'.

sections.heading: Where can I get the tax proof for section 80C?
sections.name: answer
paragraphs: You can request your tax proof for Section 80C by downloading the Mutual Fund-ELSS statement.
Steps to request your ELSS Statement:
Click the button below to go directly to the 'Reports' section.

sections.heading: Steps
items: Choose the financial year and click 'Download'.
